title: Position row
description: One venue position as the `positions` topic carries it. A flat position stays with size "0". Where all required components are known, total PnL = realizedPnlSinceFlat + unrealizedPnl, plus funding only when realizedIncludesFunding is absent or false. Fields named in unknownFields are explicitly unread: their legacy required string placeholders are not measurements and must not be shown or counted as genuine zero. Mirrors src/panel/model/frames.ts (PositionRow). See decision 0007 part 2 §9.1.

pnlAsset.description: PnL currency: the token the venue settles the market's PnL in (a Hyperliquid row carries its dex's collateral token, such as USDC or USDH). Absent: not known; a portfolio USD total leaves the row out and marks itself as not current. Hyperliquid's dollar coins count one to one; another asset converts only at a measured price.

id.description: Includes the side in hedge mode.

unknownFields.description: Additive (0037 B4): names of figures not supplied by a successful read. Suppress these figures in the UI and treat them as unavailable in calculations even if the legacy required field carries "0". Examples include funding, realizedPnlSinceFlat, fundingSinceChange, margin and leverage. Absent: retain older row semantics; a genuine measured zero is not marked unknown.

entryPrice.description: Original average entry from the venue; unchanged by session settlement. Compatibility: Bybit continues serving avgPrice (50000 in the differing-session example), never replacing it with sessionAvgPrice (55000).

valuationEntryPrice.description: Compatibility: additive optional session entry for public-mark PnL and entry-basis ROI. Bybit USDC supplies positive sessionAvgPrice (55000 while entryPrice remains 50000); settlement can advance this field without changing entryPrice. Absent on older rows: use entryPrice for both calculations. No required field or stored-record change.

realizedPnlSinceFlat.description: The exchange's own realized result for the current position lifetime, retained while flat and reset on reopen. No fee or funding normalization. Listed in unknownFields while the position's opening is not known. Compatibility: the existing decimal string and optional openedAt retain their meanings.

realizedIncludesFunding.description: Additive: true when the exchange's realized figure already includes funding. Total PnL then adds only realized and unrealized; Funding still shows the signed payment sum separately. Absent or false: the realized figure does not contain funding, so total PnL also adds funding.

fundingSinceChange.description: Funding since the position's last change of size, read from the exchange or summed from known venue payments; paid negative, received positive. Added 2026-10-06: absent from an older runtime's row.

returnOnEquity.description: Optional venue ROE ratio (not percent), including zero. Older rows omit it; display/sort falls back to the margin on the row's roeBasis.

roeBasis.description: Compatibility: additive optional margin basis (2026-11-11); absent still means entry. margin divides PnL by the reported position margin including the closing-fee reserve; missing/nonpositive/unread margin falls back to entry value divided by current leverage. entry uses valuationEntryPrice when present, otherwise entryPrice; mark uses markPrice. Bybit USDC uses entry; isolated USDT/inverse use margin; unresolved cross ROI mapping keeps entry fallback, without a parity claim. No field removed; returnOnEquity remains optional and already absent for Bybit. Other venues retain their basis.

accountMarginMode.description: Additive: the account, not the market, owns this position's margin mode (a unified account), so `marginMode` is the only mode the Leverage control offers. Absent where the market chooses its own mode, and from an older runtime.

noLeverage.description: Additive (0007 amendment 12): The exchange states no leverage for this market: `leverage` carries "0" (its value when unknown), no leverage applies there and no bot sizes by the field (Bybit's portfolio margin), beside `unknownFields` "leverage". Absent elsewhere and from an older runtime.

botId.description: The first bot of `bots`: the row's bot badge.

bots.description: The bots that hold a part of this position and how much each holds (base units; a running bot's open cycle, its close in flight, or a bot stopped without closing that still holds it); empty for a position nobody's bot holds. The person's part is the size less their sum, never below zero (ruling 397). Absent from a runtime older than 2026-10-09.

name.description: Optional already-held bot name; absent from older runtimes or an unnamed bot. No Bots subscription is needed.

botMismatch.description: The bot's own position differs from the venue's.

openedAt.description: When the position opened, from an opening among the fills the runtime has seen. Absent when it has seen none (a position already open when it first read the account): unknown, never the time of the read. Optional since 2026-10-11; a row of an older runtime always has it.

contributors.description: Origins of open own-trades books, not allocated venue size. Absent means legacy attribution.

forcedClose.description: C66 144: display-only facts from existing admitted liquidation/ADL fills in the preceding 24 hours. No live size, entry, leverage or margin is fabricated. pnl is canonical closed PnL less priced fee; absent for unpriced fee. Partial binding requires positive fill-stream episode evidence; absent/false is unknown or a later episode. Older liquidation records without position metadata yield no fact.
